They spoke especially about political and economic cooperation.
Odnose dvije zemlje opisali su kao prijateljske i kao snažno partnerstvo.
They described the relations between the two countries as friendly and as a strong partnership.
Rekli su da je važno nastaviti politički dijalog i češće organizovati posjete na najvišem nivou.
They said that it is important to continue the political dialogue and to organize visits at the highest level more often.
Na sastanku je bio i turski ministar vanjskih poslova Hakan Fidan.
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan was also at the meeting.
Informacije je objavilo Predsjedništvo BiH.
The information was published by the BiH Presidency.

title: Dodik već 17 dana nije bio u Srbiji
Dodik has not been to Serbia for 17 days
body: Milorad Dodik je ranije gotovo svake sedmice dolazio u Beograd.
Milorad Dodik used to come to Belgrade almost every week.
Od izbora u Srbiji 25. oktobra nije bio tamo već 17 dana.
Since the election in Serbia on 25 October, he has not been there for 17 days.
Te noći bio je pored Aleksandra Vučića, kada je njegova stranka izgubila vlast nakon 14 godina.
That night he was beside Aleksandar Vučić, when his party lost power after 14 years.
Vučić je tada rekao da će se uskoro vidjeti promjene u odnosima prema Republici Srpskoj i Sarajevu.
Vučić said then that changes in relations towards Republika Srpska and Sarajevo would soon be seen.
Dodik se posljednji put sa Vučićem sastao 11. oktobra u jednom beogradskom restoranu.
Dodik last met Vučić on 11 October in a Belgrade restaurant.
U Srbiji je za dvije sedmice uhapšeno više od 90 ljudi, javio je Al Jazeera Balkans.
More than 90 people have been arrested in Serbia in two weeks, Al Jazeera Balkans reported.
Među njima su visoki policajci, bankari i direktori javnih preduzeća, a u srijedu je na aerodromu uhapšen i bivši ministar Rade Basta.
Among them are senior police officers, bankers and directors of public companies, and on Wednesday former minister Rade Basta was also arrested at the airport.
Neki od uhapšenih godinama su bili dio Vučićevog sistema vlasti.
Some of those arrested were part of Vučić's system of power for years.
Zato Klix pita da li Dodik izbjegava Srbiju jer se boji hapšenja.
That is why Klix asks whether Dodik is avoiding Serbia because he is afraid of arrest.
Za Dan primirja 11. novembra Dodik nije otišao u Beograd, nego je čestitke poslao iz Banje Luke.
For Armistice Day on 11 November, Dodik did not go to Belgrade, but sent his greetings from Banja Luka.
On je čestitao pobjedu Studentskoj listi i rekao da će Republika Srpska i Srbija nastaviti saradnju.
He congratulated the Student List on its victory and said that Republika Srpska and Serbia would continue cooperation.

title: Sony isporučio više od 100 miliona konzola PlayStation 5
Sony has shipped more than 100 million PlayStation 5 consoles
body: Sony je do 10. novembra isporučio više od 100 miliona konzola PlayStation 5.
By 10 November Sony had shipped more than 100 million PlayStation 5 consoles.
To je četvrta Sonyjeva konzola koja je prešla tu granicu, nakon PS1, PS2 i PS4.
It is the fourth Sony console to pass that mark, after the PS1, PS2 and PS4.
PS5 je izašao 12. novembra 2020., pa uskoro slavi 6 godina.
The PS5 came out on 12 November 2020, so it will soon celebrate 6 years.
Broj pokazuje koliko je konzola poslano prodavnicama, a ne koliko su ih kupci kupili.
The number shows how many consoles were sent to shops, not how many customers bought.
Krajem septembra Sony je imao 97,9 miliona isporučenih konzola.
At the end of September Sony had 97.9 million shipped consoles.
Za nešto više od mjesec dana poslano je još najmanje 2,1 milion, i to prije izlaska igre GTA 6 19. novembra.
In just over a month at least 2.1 million more were sent, ahead of the release of the game GTA 6 on 19 November.
Ipak, prodaja je sporija nego ranije, jer je od jula do septembra isporučeno 2,6 miliona, a godinu prije 4 miliona.
However, sales are slower than before, because 2.6 million were shipped from July to September, compared with 4 million a year earlier.
Najbolja godina za PS5 bila je od aprila 2023. do marta 2024., s 20,8 miliona konzola.
The best year for the PS5 was from April 2023 to March 2024, with 20.8 million consoles.
Najprodavanija Sonyjeva konzola i dalje je PS2, s više od 160 miliona.
Sony's best-selling console is still the PS2, with more than 160 million.
Sony procjenjuje da PlayStation svaki mjesec koristi 127 miliona ljudi.
Sony estimates that 127 million people use PlayStation every month.

title: Sarajevske stranke se dogovorile: nova skupština u petak
Sarajevo parties agreed: new assembly on Friday
body: Predstavnici šest stranaka sastali su se u srijedu u zgradi Skupštine Kantona Sarajevo.
Representatives of six parties met on Wednesday in the building of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly.
Za istim stolom bili su i buduća vlast i buduća opozicija.
Both the future government and the future opposition were at the same table.
Razgovarali su o konstituirajućoj sjednici, to jest o prvoj sjednici nove skupštine.
They talked about the constituent session, that is, about the first session of the new assembly.
Na sastanku su bili SDA, DF, NiP, SDP, Stranka za BiH i Naša stranka.
SDA, DF, NiP, SDP, the Party for BiH and Naša stranka were at the meeting.
Sjednica počinje u petak u 08:30, a tada će se izabrati i komisija od 7 članova.
The session starts on Friday at 08:30, and a commission of 7 members will also be chosen then.
U komisiji će biti 4 člana vlasti i 3 člana opozicije.
There will be 4 members of the government and 3 members of the opposition on the commission.
Sjednica će se morati prekinuti jer CIK još nije potvrdio 4 ili 5 mandata.
The session will have to be interrupted because the CEC has not yet confirmed 4 or 5 mandates.
Aljoša Čampara iz NiP-a rekao je da nema nikakve priče o blokadi.
Aljoša Čampara from NiP said that there is no talk at all of a blockade.
Sjednica bi se trebala nastaviti 7 dana kasnije, kada će se birati predsjedavajući skupštine.
The session should continue 7 days later, when the speaker of the assembly will be chosen.
Čampara je rekao da je atmosfera bila konstruktivna i da svi žele brzo formirati novu vladu.
Čampara said that the atmosphere was constructive and that everyone wants to form the new government quickly.
Albin Zuhrić iz DF-a također ne očekuje blokadu.
Albin Zuhrić from DF also does not expect a blockade.

title: U Zagrebu održana komemoracija za Mišu Kovača
Commemoration for Mišo Kovač held in Zagreb
body: U koncertnoj dvorani Vatroslav Lisinski u Zagrebu održana je komemoracija za pjevača Mišu Kovača.
A commemoration for the singer Mišo Kovač was held in the Vatroslav Lisinski concert hall in Zagreb.
Organizovala ju je diskografska kuća Croatia Records.
It was organized by the record company Croatia Records.
Porodica, prijatelji i kolege upisali su se u knjigu žalosti, koja će biti predata porodici.
Family, friends and colleagues signed the book of condolences, which will be handed to the family.
Došla je Kovačeva supruga Lidija s kćerkom Ivanom i unukom Elenom.
Kovač's wife Lidija came with her daughter Ivana and granddaughter Elena.
Bili su tu i muzičari Željko Bebek i Nikša Bratoš.
The musicians Željko Bebek and Nikša Bratoš were also there.
Došli su i hrvatski premijer Andrej Plenković i nekoliko ministara.
The Croatian prime minister Andrej Plenković and several ministers also came.
Pjevač Jacques Houdek rekao je da je Kovač pjesma naše duše i muzika života njegovih roditelja.
The singer Jacques Houdek said that Kovač is the song of our soul and the music of his parents' lives.
Mišo Kovač sahranjen je 4. novembra na zagrebačkom groblju Mirogoj.
Mišo Kovač was buried on 4 November at Zagreb's Mirogoj cemetery.
Sahranjen je pored sina Edija, koji je umro 1992. godine.
He was buried next to his son Edi, who died in 1992.
Dan prije sahrane, ljudi su se od njega oprostili na stadionu Poljud u Splitu.
The day before the funeral, people said goodbye to him at the Poljud stadium in Split.
Svih 33.000 besplatnih ulaznica podijeljeno je za nekoliko sati.
All 33,000 free tickets were handed out in a few hours.

title: Policija zaplijenila ulje za 700 kilograma droge
Police seized oil for 700 kilograms of drugs
body: Federalna uprava policije objavila je u srijedu detalje velike akcije protiv droge pod nazivom „Vrtlog“.
The Federal Police Administration on Wednesday published details of a large anti-drug operation called “Vortex”.
U akciji je uhapšeno 15 osoba iz Sarajeva i Zenice.
In the operation, 15 people from Sarajevo and Zenica were arrested.
Pretresi su bili u tri kantona u Federaciji i u Republici Srpskoj.
The searches were in three cantons in the Federation and in Republika Srpska.
Policija je pronašla 83 litra amfetaminskog ulja, a to je sirovina za proizvodnju droge.
The police found 83 litres of amphetamine oil, which is a raw material for producing drugs.
Iz tog ulja moglo se napraviti između 600 i 700 kilograma amfetamina.
Between 600 and 700 kilograms of amphetamine could have been made from that oil.
Zaplijenjeno je i oko 58 kilograma kanabisa i oko 39 kilograma amfetamina.
About 58 kilograms of cannabis and about 39 kilograms of amphetamine were also seized.
Policajci su oduzeli i nekoliko pištolja, mobitele i vage za drogu.
The police officers also took away several pistols, mobile phones and scales for drugs.
Akciju su vodili policija i MUP Zeničko-dobojskog kantona, uz pomoć obavještajne agencije OSA.
The operation was led by the police and the Interior Ministry of Zenica-Doboj Canton, with help from the intelligence agency OSA.
Osumnjičeni su za organizovani kriminal, prodaju droge i pranje novca.
The suspects are suspected of organized crime, selling drugs and money laundering.
Nakon obrade u policiji, bit će predati Federalnom tužilaštvu.
After processing at the police, they will be handed over to the Federal Prosecutor's Office.
Policija je rekla da istraga još traje.
The police said that the investigation is still going on.

title: CIK podijelio nove mandate u državnom parlamentu
CEC handed out new mandates in the state parliament
body: Centralna izborna komisija BiH dodijelila je nove mandate u državnom parlamentu.
The Central Election Commission of BiH assigned new mandates in the state parliament.
Neki političari ne mogu biti zastupnici jer su ministri ili gradonačelnici.
Some politicians cannot be representatives because they are ministers or mayors.
Zato su svoje mandate stavili u mirovanje, a na njihova mjesta privremeno dolaze drugi.
That is why they put their mandates on hold, and others temporarily take their places.
U Domu naroda četiri delegata su dala ostavku jer su izabrana u Predstavnički dom.
In the House of Peoples, four delegates resigned because they were elected to the House of Representatives.
Na njihova mjesta dolaze Tamara Evđić, Mensur Beganović, Mirnes Gušić i Ivan Vukadin.
Tamara Evđić, Mensur Beganović, Mirnes Gušić and Ivan Vukadin come in their places.
U Predstavničkom domu 10 zastupnika stavilo je mandat u mirovanje.
In the House of Representatives, 10 representatives put their mandate on hold.
Među njima su Zukan Helez iz SDP-a, Draško Stanivuković i Zoran Stevanović.
Among them are Zukan Helez from SDP, Draško Stanivuković and Zoran Stevanović.
CIK je odbio zahtjev Mirne Savić Banjac, jer je rekao da nije osnovan.
The CEC rejected the request of Mirna Savić Banjac, because it said that it was not justified.
Nove mandate dobili su i zastupnici u Narodnoj skupštini Republike Srpske.
Representatives in the National Assembly of Republika Srpska also received new mandates.
Na istoj sjednici CIK je dozvolio nekim strankama da kazne plate u ratama.
At the same session, the CEC allowed some parties to pay fines in instalments.

title: Na Ilidži uhapšena dvojica zbog otmice pet Kineza
Two men arrested in Ilidža over the kidnapping of five Chinese
body: Federalna uprava policije uhapsila je na Ilidži dvojicu državljana Kine.
The Federal Police Administration arrested two citizens of China in Ilidža.
Sumnja se da su oteli pet Kineza dok su ih ilegalno vozili prema Italiji.
They are suspected of kidnapping five Chinese people while they were illegally driving them towards Italy.
Za svakog su tražili 15.000 eura otkupnine i prijetili su im smrću.
They demanded 15,000 euros of ransom for each of them and threatened them with death.
Pretresi su bili 6. novembra po nalogu Suda BiH.
The searches were on 6 November on the order of the Court of BiH.
Policija je oduzela mobitele i novac u različitim valutama.
The police took away mobile phones and money in different currencies.
Prema policiji, žrtve su na putu prema granici bile zatvorene i zlostavljane.
According to the police, the victims were locked up and abused on the way to the border.
Morale su predati novac, a neke su plaćale i preko aplikacija na mobitelu.
They had to hand over money, and some also paid through apps on their phones.
Policija je podnijela prijavu protiv tri osobe, dvojice Kineza i jednog državljanina Pakistana.
The police filed a report against three people, two Chinese men and one citizen of Pakistan.
Sumnjiče se da su organizovali grupu za krijumčarenje migranata, to jest ilegalni prevoz ljudi preko granice.
They are suspected of organizing a group for migrant smuggling, that is, illegally transporting people across the border.
Dvojica uhapšenih predata su Službi za poslove sa strancima.
The two arrested men were handed over to the Service for Foreigners' Affairs.
Policija još traži druge osobe povezane s ovim slučajem.
The police are still looking for other people connected with this case.

title: Uhapšene 11 osoba iz dvije kriminalne grupe
11 people from two criminal groups arrested
body: Policija je u srijedu ujutro uhapsila 11 osoba iz dvije kriminalne grupe.
On Wednesday morning the police arrested 11 people from two criminal groups.
Sumnja se da su prodavali drogu i prali novac.
They are suspected of selling drugs and laundering money.
Među uhapšenima su Muharem Smajlović, Edib Džedžibeg i Selma Bogučanin.
Among those arrested are Muharem Smajlović, Edib Džedžibeg and Selma Bogučanin.
Selma je supruga Amela Bogučanina, kojeg policija već dugo poznaje.
Selma is the wife of Amel Bogučanin, whom the police have known for a long time.
Policija je tražila ukupno 13 osoba, ali je jedna u bolnici, a jedna je pobjegla.
The police were looking for a total of 13 people, but one is in hospital and one has fled.
Pretresi su bili u četiri kantona i u Republici Srpskoj.
The searches were in four cantons and in Republika Srpska.
Tužilaštvo kaže da je od augusta do oktobra zaplijenjeno više od 50 kilograma droge.
The prosecutor's office says that more than 50 kilograms of drugs were seized from August to October.
Klix.ba je saznao da je sve počelo hapšenjem jednog stražara iz zatvora u Zenici.
Klix.ba learned that everything started with the arrest of a guard from the prison in Zenica.
Ibrahim Handanović (29) uhapšen je 22. oktobra nakon potjere.
Ibrahim Handanović (29) was arrested on 22 October after a chase.
Tokom bijega bacio je kroz prozor auta torbu s više od 1 kilograma kanabisa.
During the escape he threw a bag with more than 1 kilogram of cannabis out of the car window.

title: Ko bi mogao biti novi premijer Republike Srpske
Who could be the new prime minister of Republika Srpska
body: Igor Dodik i Zoran Stevanović su najozbiljniji kandidati za novog premijera Republike Srpske.
Igor Dodik and Zoran Stevanović are the most serious candidates for the new prime minister of Republika Srpska.
To je Klix.ba saznao od izvora u Banjoj Luci.
Klix.ba learned this from sources in Banja Luka.
Obojica su iz stranke SNSD.
Both of them are from the SNSD party.
Igor Dodik je organizacioni sekretar SNSD-a i sin predsjednika stranke Milorada Dodika.
Igor Dodik is the organizational secretary of SNSD and the son of the party president Milorad Dodik.
Njega podržavaju mlađi političari i nekoliko općinskih odbora stranke.
He is supported by younger politicians and several municipal boards of the party.
Zoran Stevanović je sada ministar saobraćaja, a ranije je bio gradonačelnik Zvornika.
Zoran Stevanović is now the minister of transport, and earlier he was the mayor of Zvornik.
Njega podržavaju brojni biznismeni iz istočne Bosne.
He is supported by many businessmen from eastern Bosnia.
Obje strane će narednih dana tražiti podršku, ali posljednju riječ bi opet mogao imati Milorad Dodik.
Both sides will look for support in the coming days, but Milorad Dodik could again have the last word.
Novi premijer i nova vlada očekuju se do sredine decembra.
The new prime minister and the new government are expected by mid-December.
Prije toga Željka Cvijanović treba dobiti novi mandat u Predsjedništvu BiH.
Before that, Željka Cvijanović is to get a new term in the Presidency of BiH.
Savo Minić bi trebao postati predsjednik Republike Srpske.
Savo Minić should become the president of Republika Srpska.

title: Čistiji zrak u spavaćoj sobi može pomoći kod šećera
Cleaner air in the bedroom can help with blood sugar
body: Istraživači iz New Yorka otkrili su da prečišćivači zraka u spavaćoj sobi mogu pomoći ljudima s predijabetesom.
Researchers from New York found that air purifiers in the bedroom can help people with prediabetes.
Predijabetes znači da je šećer u krvi viši nego što treba, ali to još nije dijabetes.
Prediabetes means that blood sugar is higher than it should be, but it is not yet diabetes.
Rezultati su predstavljeni 8. novembra.
The results were presented on 8 November.
U istraživanju je bilo više od 150 muškaraca i žena.
More than 150 men and women took part in the study.
Pola njih je mjesec dana spavalo s pravim HEPA filterima, a druga polovina s uređajima koji ne čiste zrak.
Half of them slept for a month with real HEPA filters, and the other half with devices that do not clean the air.
Pravi filteri smanjili su sitne štetne čestice u zraku za 36 posto.
The real filters reduced fine harmful particles in the air by 36 percent.
Kod tih ljudi šećer je nakon doručka bio niži za oko 17 posto.
In these people, sugar after breakfast was about 17 percent lower.
Autorica studije Sharine Wittkopp rekla je da je čišći zrak kod kuće jednostavna i jeftina pomoć.
The study's author Sharine Wittkopp said that cleaner air at home is simple and cheap help.
Ipak, filter ne zamjenjuje zdravu hranu, sport i lijekove.
Still, a filter does not replace healthy food, exercise and medicine.
Jonathan Newman je rekao da rezultati možda ne vrijede za ljude koji već imaju dijabetes.
Jonathan Newman said that the results may not apply to people who already have diabetes.
Tim planira duža istraživanja.
The team is planning longer studies.

title: Voyager 1 uskoro jedan svjetlosni dan od Zemlje
Voyager 1 soon one light-day from Earth
body: NASA-ina letjelica Voyager 1 bit će 18. novembra tačno jedan svjetlosni dan daleko od Zemlje.
NASA's spacecraft Voyager 1 will be exactly one light-day away from Earth on 18 November.
To znači da svjetlost s Zemlje do nje putuje cijela 24 sata.
This means that light from Earth travels to it for a full 24 hours.
Letjelica je lansirana 1977. godine i danas je najudaljeniji predmet koji su napravili ljudi.
The spacecraft was launched in 1977 and today it is the most distant object made by people.
Voyager 1 je oko 25,89 milijardi kilometara od nas i leti brzinom od oko 61.155 kilometara na sat.
Voyager 1 is about 25.89 billion kilometres from us and flies at a speed of about 61,155 kilometres per hour.
Poruka do letjelice putuje jedan dan, a odgovor se vraća još jedan dan.
A message travels to the spacecraft for one day, and the answer comes back in another day.
Menadžerica projekta Suzanne Dodd rekla je da pošaljete poruku, odete kući i čekate dva dana.
Project manager Suzanne Dodd said that you send a message, go home and wait two days.
Letjelica svake godine gubi oko 4 vata snage, pa tim gasi sisteme koji nisu važni.
The spacecraft loses about 4 watts of power every year, so the team switches off systems that are not important.
NASA poziva ljude da 17. novembra nakon zalaska sunca zasvijetle mobitelima.
NASA invites people to light up with their phones on 17 November after sunset.
Telefoni će Morseovom azbukom slati znak „VGR“, ime letjelice.
The phones will send the sign “VGR”, the spacecraft's name, in Morse code.
Dva dana kasnije bit će i razgovor s naučnicima, koji će se prenositi na internetu.
Two days later there will also be a talk with scientists, which will be broadcast on the internet.
Misija će 2027. godine proslaviti 50 godina.
The mission will celebrate 50 years in 2027.

title: Uk i Hasanović ostaju u Vladi KS, Hota-Muminović odlazi
Uk and Hasanović stay in the Sarajevo Canton government, Hota-Muminović leaves
body: U utorak u 16 sati istekao je rok u kojem su izabrani zvaničnici morali reći da li prihvataju mandat.
On Tuesday at 4 p.m. the deadline expired by which elected officials had to say whether they accept their mandate.
Zato je sada jasnije ko ostaje u Vladi Kantona Sarajevo, a ko odlazi u Skupštinu KS.
That is why it is now clearer who stays in the Sarajevo Canton government and who goes to the Canton Assembly.
Premijer Nihad Uk i ministar zdravstva Enis Hasanović ostaju u Vladi dok se ne formira nova.
Prime Minister Nihad Uk and Health Minister Enis Hasanović stay in the government until a new one is formed.
Uk je prihvatio mandat u Predstavničkom domu Parlamenta FBiH, ali ga je zamrznuo.
Uk accepted a mandate in the House of Representatives of the FBiH Parliament, but he froze it.
Hasanović je izabran u Skupštinu KS, a i on je stavio mandat na čekanje.
Hasanović was elected to the Canton Assembly, and he also put his mandate on hold.
Rekao je da će ostati ministar dok se ne formira nova vlada i da se nada da će to biti uskoro.
He said that he will remain minister until a new government is formed and that he hopes it will be soon.
Ministrica obrazovanja Naida Hota-Muminović odmah napušta Vladu i prelazi u Skupštinu.
Education Minister Naida Hota-Muminović is leaving the government right away and moving to the Assembly.
Na Facebooku je napisala da je bila ministrica skoro 6 godina.
On Facebook she wrote that she had been minister for almost 6 years.
Ministar kulture i sporta Kenan Magoda ranije je u utorak također prihvatio mandat u Skupštini.
Culture and Sports Minister Kenan Magoda also accepted a mandate in the Assembly earlier on Tuesday.
Ministar saobraćaja Adnan Šteta odlučio je da ne preuzme mjesto u Skupštini.
Transport Minister Adnan Šteta decided not to take his seat in the Assembly.
Vlada KS je u tehničkom mandatu od februara, nakon što je Uk podnio ostavku zbog nesreće tramvaja.
The Canton government has been in a caretaker mandate since February, after Uk resigned because of a tram accident.
Vlada ima 13 članova i može odlučivati ako na sjednici bude najmanje 7.
The government has 13 members and can make decisions if at least 7 are at the session.

title: Vukanović: Dodik je Stanivukoviću ponudio tri ministarstva
Vukanović: Dodik offered Stanivuković three ministries
body: Nebojša Vukanović tvrdi da je Milorad Dodik ponudio Drašku Stanivukoviću tri ministarstva u Vladi Republike Srpske.
Nebojša Vukanović claims that Milorad Dodik offered Draško Stanivuković three ministries in the Government of Republika Srpska.
Prema njegovim informacijama, PSS bi dobio ministarstva energetike, poljoprivrede i sporta.
According to his information, PSS would get the ministries of energy, agriculture and sport.
Uz to, stranci bi pripale i niže funkcije u vlasti.
In addition, the party would also get lower positions in government.
Sastanak delegacija SNSD-a, SDS-a i PSS-a bio je zakazan za utorak u 16:30, ali nije održan.
A meeting of the SNSD, SDS and PSS delegations was scheduled for Tuesday at 16:30, but it did not take place.
SDS je u 12:35 poslao pismo u ime predsjednika stranke Branka Blanuše.
At 12:35 SDS sent a letter on behalf of party president Branko Blanuša.
U pismu piše da delegacija iz objektivnih razloga ne može doći u dogovoreno vrijeme.
The letter says that the delegation cannot come at the agreed time for objective reasons.
SDS je predložio sastanak u srijedu, 11. novembra, u Narodnoj skupštini ili Vladi RS-a.
SDS proposed a meeting on Wednesday, 11 November, at the National Assembly or the RS Government.
Dodik je ranije rekao da je SDS i PSS prije 5 dana pozvao na razgovore o vladi nacionalnog jedinstva.
Dodik said earlier that he had invited SDS and PSS to talks on a government of national unity 5 days ago.
Vukanović je rekao da ton pisma govori više od 1.000 riječi.
Vukanović said that the tone of the letter says more than 1,000 words.
Po njegovim riječima, Blanuša i Dodik sarađuju od ljeta, a to se više ne krije od javnosti.
In his words, Blanuša and Dodik have been cooperating since the summer, and this is no longer hidden from the public.
Vukanović tvrdi da Stanivuković neće prihvatiti ponudu i da će zato doći do cijepanja PSS-a, odnosno da će se stranka podijeliti.
Vukanović claims that Stanivuković will not accept the offer and that this will lead to a split in PSS, meaning the party will divide.

title: Irak zatvara jedan prijelaz s Iranom, a otvara drugi
Iraq closes one crossing with Iran but opens another
body: Irak je u utorak ponovo otvorio granični prijelaz Sheeb s Iranom, u provinciji Maysan.
On Tuesday Iraq reopened the Sheeb border crossing with Iran, in Maysan province.
U isto vrijeme vlasti su najavile da će od petka zatvoriti prijelaz Mandali u provinciji Diyala.
At the same time the authorities announced that they will close the Mandali crossing in Diyala province from Friday.
Kažu da je razlog tehnički: radovi i modernizacija prije kišne sezone.
They say the reason is technical: works and modernisation before the rainy season.
Prijelaz Sheeb bio je zatvoren od 21. oktobra.
The Sheeb crossing had been closed since 21 October.
Ministar vanjskih poslova Fuad Hussein rekao je da Washington traži da Irak zatvori sve prijelaze s Iranom osim dva.
Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said that Washington wants Iraq to close all crossings with Iran except two.
Hussein smatra da bi zatvaranje svih prijelaza bilo teško i da bi naštetilo ekonomiji.
Hussein believes that closing all the crossings would be difficult and would harm the economy.
Trgovina između Iraka i Irana vrijedi od 15 do 18 milijardi dolara godišnje.
Trade between Iraq and Iran is worth 15 to 18 billion dollars a year.
Od toga oko 4 milijarde dolara otpada na iranski prirodni plin.
Of that, about 4 billion dollars is for Iranian natural gas.
Nije jasno da li su odluke o prijelazima povezane sa zahtjevom SAD-a.
It is not clear whether the decisions on the crossings are linked to the US request.
Vozači kamiona i trgovci u Maysanu protestovali su zbog zatvaranja, jer su cijene porasle.
Truck drivers and traders in Maysan protested against the closure because prices went up.
Američka vojska je u subotu pokrenula tim „Iron Gate“ koji treba spriječiti prenos oružja preko iranskih granica.
On Saturday the US military launched the "Iron Gate" task force, which is meant to stop weapons being moved across Iran's borders.
Iranska Revolucionarna garda odbacila je tu inicijativu.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard rejected that initiative.

title: Ko je Alexander Alden, čovjek sa sarajevskog Bistrika
Who is Alexander Alden, the man from Sarajevo's Bistrik
body: Klix.ba je saznao nove detalje iz života Alexandera Aldena, koji se ranije zvao Alden Mulabdić.
Klix.ba has learned new details from the life of Alexander Alden, who used to be called Alden Mulabdić.
Rođen je u Italiji, vjerovatno u Veroni, ali je odrastao na Bistriku u Sarajevu.
He was born in Italy, probably in Verona, but he grew up in Bistrik in Sarajevo.
Njegov otac Muhamed bio je u gradu poznat kao Muha, a majka je srpskog porijekla.
His father Muhamed was known in the city as Muha, and his mother is of Serbian origin.
Alden danas ima između 45 i 47 godina.
Alden is now between 45 and 47 years old.
Iz Sarajeva je otišao u Italiju sa 12 godina, a u New York se preselio sa 18, nakon što mu je umro otac.
He left Sarajevo for Italy at 12, and moved to New York at 18, after his father died.
U Americi je napravio akademsku karijeru i promijenio identitet.
In America he built an academic career and changed his identity.
Niko od njegove uže porodice više ne živi u Sarajevu.
None of his close family lives in Sarajevo anymore.
Američki portal Semafor piše da Alden u State Departmentu zastupa političke interese Milorada Dodika.
The American outlet Semafor writes that Alden represents Milorad Dodik's political interests in the State Department.
Prema tom portalu, u junu je pritiskao evropske zvaničnike da prihvate američkog kandidata za visokog predstavnika.
According to that outlet, in June he pressured European officials to accept the American candidate for High Representative.
Evropljani su tog kandidata, italijanskog diplomatu Antonija Zanardija Landija, ipak odbili.
The Europeans nevertheless rejected that candidate, Italian diplomat Antonio Zanardi Landi.
State Department je potvrdio da je Alden bio na sastancima i rekao je da ima puno povjerenje rukovodstva.
The State Department confirmed that Alden was at the meetings and said that he has the full trust of its leadership.
Semafor navodi i da je Vlada RS-a od 2025. potrošila više od 11 miliona dolara na lobiranje kod Trumpove administracije.
Semafor also states that the RS government has spent more than 11 million dollars on lobbying the Trump administration since 2025.

title: Florence Pugh: Žena nikad ne može izgledati kako treba
Florence Pugh: A woman can never look right
body: Britanska glumica Florence Pugh govorila je za magazin ELLE o komentarima na izgled žena u Hollywoodu.
British actress Florence Pugh spoke to ELLE magazine about comments on women's looks in Hollywood.
Ona ima 30 godina i jedna je od zvijezda decembarskog broja tog magazina.
She is 30 years old and one of the stars of the magazine's December issue.
Rekla je da se žene stalno ocjenjuju po izgledu, odjeći i godinama.
She said that women are constantly judged by their looks, clothes and age.
Po njenim riječima, kritike dolaze i kada žena dobije i kada izgubi kilograme.
In her words, criticism comes both when a woman gains and when she loses weight.
Zato smatra da nikad ne možeš pogoditi kako treba.
That is why she thinks you can never get it right.
Pugh kaže da je najbolje uloge imala kada se osjećala najmanje lijepom.
Pugh says she gave her best performances when she felt least beautiful.
Ružna šminka, bolest ili umor daju joj slobodu pred kamerom.
Unflattering make-up, illness or tiredness give her freedom in front of the camera.
Ova godina mogla bi biti najveća u njenoj karijeri, s nekoliko velikih filmova i serijom za Netflix.
This year could be the biggest of her career, with several big films and a series for Netflix.
Glumica je 2022. ispričala da su joj sa 19 godina tražili da promijeni težinu, lice i obrve.
In 2022 the actress said that at 19 she was asked to change her weight, face and eyebrows.
To je bilo nakon što je dobila glavnu ulogu u jednoj seriji.
That was after she got the lead role in a series.
Danas kaže da je naučila zaštititi sebe.
Today she says she has learned to protect herself.
Na snimanju više ne trpi loše ponašanje i želi kolege koji su tačni i puni poštovanja.
On set she no longer tolerates bad behaviour and wants colleagues who are punctual and respectful.

title: Kenan Magoda iz Vlade KS odlazi u Skupštinu
Kenan Magoda leaves the Canton government for the Assembly
body: Ministar kulture i sporta Kantona Sarajevo Kenan Magoda prihvatio je mandat u Skupštini KS.
Sarajevo Canton Culture and Sports Minister Kenan Magoda has accepted a mandate in the Canton Assembly.
On je to u utorak potvrdio za Klix.ba.
He confirmed this to Klix.ba on Tuesday.
Zbog toga više neće biti član kantonalne vlade, jer se te dvije funkcije ne mogu obavljati u isto vrijeme.
Because of this he will no longer be a member of the cantonal government, as the two roles cannot be held at the same time.
Prema Izbornom zakonu BiH, izabrani zastupnik ne može istovremeno raditi u izvršnoj vlasti.
According to the BiH Election Law, an elected representative cannot work in the executive branch at the same time.
Zvaničnici su mogli izabrati i drugi put: da zamrznu mandat i ostanu ministri do formiranja nove vlade.
Officials could also choose another way: freeze the mandate and remain ministers until a new government is formed.
Takvo zamrzavanje ne može trajati kraće od 6 mjeseci.
Such a freeze cannot last less than 6 months.
Prazno mjesto ministra mora se popuniti u roku od 30 dana.
An empty minister's post must be filled within 30 days.
Do tada poslove ministarstva vodi član vlade kojeg odredi premijer.
Until then, the ministry's work is led by a government member whom the prime minister appoints.
Ministar saobraćaja Adnan Šteta, koji je na izborima dobio 21.824 glasa, odlučio je ostati u vladi.
Transport Minister Adnan Šteta, who won 21,824 votes in the elections, decided to stay in the government.
On je zamrznuo mandat u Skupštini.
He froze his mandate in the Assembly.
Premijer Nihad Uk dobio je mjesto u Predstavničkom domu Parlamenta FBiH.
Prime Minister Nihad Uk got a seat in the House of Representatives of the FBiH Parliament.
Ministar za boračka pitanja Omer Osmanović nije direktno izabran u Skupštinu.
Veterans' Affairs Minister Omer Osmanović was not directly elected to the Assembly.
